The position also requires managing relationships with media vendors, monitoring campaign effectiveness, and ensuring maximum exposure for each product. Collaborate with external agencies, media vendors, and suppliers to source and manage high-quality outdoor advertising opportunities, ensuring efficient use of the marketing budget.
